Consider the data in [table-lst-squares-multi].

A simple dataset $x_1$ $x_2$ $y$ 1 1 4.2 1 2 3.3 2 1 5.9 2 2 5.1 3 2 7.5 3 3 6.3

Set up a linear system $A\xvec = \bvec$ that describes the relationship $$ \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_1 + \beta_2 x_2 = y. $$

Find the least-squares approximate solution $\xhat$.

What is your predicted $y$-value when $x_1 = 2.4$ and $x_2=2.9$?

Find the coefficient of determination $R^2$.
A set of vectors whose span is $\real^m$ contains at least $m$ vectors.
